title: Owner Auto Policy Premium Written and Additional Premium
content:
**Status condition.** Premium is written on an Owner Auto Policy term only when the term's status is bound, renewal offered or in force. This is read from the term's recorded status before the premium is booked.

**Premium written.** Premium written equals the term's full-term premium. It is booked once when a new-business term is bound, and once when a renewal term is accepted, with premium days of 0.

**Additional premium.**
- **Rated driver added.** The clause "Additional premium for a rated driver added is the driver's full-term premium share multiplied by the days from the change effective date to the expiration date and divided by the term's days" is no longer in force as a rule for every added driver. Three listings carry their own premium:
  - the listing that precedes the exclusion of the resident named on the term's latest Named Driver Exclusion form by signing date, when that resident is reported operating a scheduled vehicle on a claim of the term while unlisted and carries no driver-added entry on the term;
  - the re-listing of the household resident on the term's latest claim report recording an unlisted household resident, when that resident was rated earlier in the term by a driver-added entry and is not the resident named on the term's latest Named Driver Exclusion form;
  - the lift of the exclusion of the driver on the term's latest claim report recording a named excluded driver.

  Every other driver added is still charged the driver's full-term premium share multiplied by the days from the change effective date to the expiration date and divided by the term's days.
- **Added vehicle:** the vehicle's full-term premium share, prorated the same way.
- **Limits increase:** the full-term premium difference, prorated the same way.
- **Reinstatement:** additional premium for a reinstatement is computed under the reinstatement rules. Without lapse it is re-written in full; with lapse it is prorated.

**Rounding and billing.** Every amount is rounded to the nearest cent, half up, and is charged to the term's billing plan.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A vehicle with a full-term share of 402.00 is added with 91 days remaining in a 182-day term. The additional premium is 402.00 multiplied by 91 and divided by 182, which is 201.00.

superseded_clauses: Additional premium for a rated driver added is driver_term_premium multiplied by the days from the change effective date to the expiration date and divided by term_days;
